name: Jiphdeh
title: Warrior from the Tribe of Benjamin
summary: Jiphdeh was one of the brave warriors from the tribe of Benjamin mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Shimri and belonged to one of the prominent families in Benjamin. He is listed among the heads of households who lived in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the Genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Jiphdeh is mentioned as the son of Shimri in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin, among the prominent heads of families.

keyEvents.title: Head of a family in Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Jifdeja is counted among the heads of families in the tribe of Benjamin, who were leaders over their households through generations.

keyEvents.title: Living in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Jifdeja and his relatives were among the Benjamites living in Jerusalem, indicating a position of some prominence.

keyEvents.title: Part of the inheritance of the tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Benjamin, Jifdeja belonged to the tribe that remained loyal to the kingdom of Judah after the division of the kingdom.
